nom: bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide

avis.texte: The product feels like water, but it seems to be making a difference. My skin looks better, but is still lacking moisture. This also seems to contain something that is tingly, so don't use on eye area excessively.

I have sensitive combination skin that usually reacts to everything, but this serum has been a great. It's lightweight and sinks in immediately without feeling sticky. My skin feels smooth much and less reactive. It's the perfect base for my moisturizer. The scent is also not bad, it's light and fresh.

They changed everything and took away the products that been working for me. I tried the new lines and even the ingredients are not the same .My retinol face cream you took away and oil free products too. Sadly I have to search for a new skin line Bare Minerals bring everything back so I can comeback.

avis.titre: Less Active Ingredients for Higher Prices
avis.texte: First world problems I guess, but this is a heartbreaking reformulation. Niacinamide use to be one of the top three ingredients, but it's been bumped down in favor of cheap fillers. The long life herb removed. The texture is off. It doesn't leave my skin feeling moisturized, or anything really. I've been using Skinglongevity since it launched a decade ago. I stuck with it through its previous reformulation, but this is pure skimpification. I've been looking for years for a dupe, but never found an ingredient list that came close. It's sad, but the serum that healed my skin and has had people asking what I do to keep my face looking bright and youthful and healthy for ten years is just gone.

avis.titre: SUPER DISAPPOINTED! BRING BACK OG FORMULA !!!
avis.texte: I have been using this product since Bare Minerals introduced the skinlongevity line and had AMAZING results. This was my miracle product and the only multi purpose serum that kept my skin hydrated, radiant and blemish free. I am extremely disappointed because i struggled with cycstic acne for many, many years and this was one product that truly healed my skin barrier. The new formula is drying and I see zero benefit. Please bring back the old formula :'(

I've been using the SKINLONGEVITY® Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide, and it has quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. From the first few uses, my skin felt noticeably more hydrated, calmer, and balanced. The serum has a lightweight, silky texture that absorbs beautifully without feeling greasy or heavy, making it perfect for both morning and evening use. What I love most is how well it supports my skin barrier. My complexion looks smoother and more resilient, and I've noticed less redness and irritation over time. The niacinamide really shines here—my skin tone appears more even, and my pores look more refined. It layers well under moisturizer and makeup, and I haven't experienced any breakouts or sensitivity. Overall, this serum delivers exactly what it promises: nourishment, hydration, and a healthier-looking glow. If you're looking for a gentle yet effective serum that strengthens your skin barrier and leaves your skin feeling comfortable and radiant, this one is absolutely worth trying.

I have been using this product for years with wonderful results. I have absolutely no idea why you would change the formula. Must of came down to saving a few bucks. The product was superior to all serums I have ever tried. I will not be purchasing this new serum again. EXTREMELY DISAPPOINTED

avis.titre: We want the Long Life Herb formula!!!
avis.texte: I am so disappointed they discontinued the skin lovevity long life herb serum. That ingredient that was sourced from Japan was the star of the show!!!! This new serum doesnt have it. Not worth the price. The quality doesnt compare.

avis.titre: This new formulation is drying out my skin!
avis.texte: I had used two bottles of the original Skinlongevity Longlife Herb Serum and I was very happy with the results. I ordered my 3rd bottle and noticed the formulation had changed and I was skeptical but remained hopeful that it will be good as the first. Wrong! This new one makes my skin look dry and dull looking. The original product made my skin look radiant and bright and moisturized; it also had a fresh almost lemony scent but subtle. What a difference! I would like to return this product. Clearly, it's doing me more harm than good.
Ive been putting this serum on right after my normal hyaluronic acid and my skin has never looked better. It seems more even toned, moisturized, and my pores look smaller

avis.titre: Bring back the original Skinlongevity serum!
avis.texte: I am so disappointed in Bare Minerals. The original Skinlongevity Serum was amazing. It always felt so light and refreshing and it had the most pleasant scent. This version leaves my skin feeling tight and the smell is definitely very off. If you have never used the original, this one might seem o.k., but it definitely is an inferior product and they are charging more for it. I have been a very loyal Bare Mineral customer for years and I will not purchase this again.

I have used the bare minerals SKINLONGEVITY serum for over a month and have noticed a dramatic change in my skin! My skin is more supple and nourished and my fine lines have smoothed out tremendously! I have always been a fan of bare minerals products and this serum is everything I expected and more! I will not be without this serum in my routine now!
OMG!!! I love it, I've been trying it for weeks, and my face is softer, super hydrated, the subtexture is creamy, it's a complete serum, its ingredients are vegan,

avis.titre: Dramatic results with ingredients I can pronounce!
avis.texte: After using this serum for several weeks, my skin feels noticeably firmer and more lifted. It was gentle and kind to my very sensitive, redness-prone skin. The fine lines on my forehead and my neck appear softer, and my overall complexion looks more radiant and refreshed. I am thrilled to find such dramatic results from a "clean beauty" line.

I used this free sample for my PM skincare routine. I liked the feel on my skin, and how it felt lightweight on my pores. It's perfect after washing my face and before putting on my moisturizer. After using it for two weeks, I felt my skin noticeably brighter and smoother.

I've been using this product for a couple weeks now and I really like it. There are a lot of positives in just a couple negatives and that is why I only gave it four stars. The positive include how fast it dries. I feel like I'm not waiting around to do the next step in my face routine and I really like that. It feels really nice when it's applied as well. The only negatives I have are I'm not a huge fan of the smell, but it's not awful either. It wouldn't deter me from buying this in the future. The only other negative and it's really not that big of a deal. Is that the directions say to use two pumps over your face and neck area and I find myself needing more like three pumps. Overall, the very good product and I would recommend.

SKINLONGEVITY® Serum with Niacinamide: - It's like a superhero for your skin! It strengthens the barrier, keeps your skin hydrated, and protects it from daily damage. - It reduces the signs of aging, like fine lines and wrinkles, and makes your skin look smoother and plumper. - It's packed with nutrients that nourish your skin and help repair the barrier, so it's extra hydrated and radiant. - It soothes and calms your skin, reducing redness and making it smoother. - And guess what? It's clean and vegan! It's gluten-free, free from synthetic fragrances, parabens, sulfates, PEGs, and more. Key ingredients: - Mineral Herb Complex: It's like a shield that fights aging signs and strengthens your skin's barrier. - Zinc-infused Niacinamide: It reduces fine lines, wrinkles, and soothes inflammation and redness. - California Poppy: It's like a shield that protects your skin from free radicals and environmental damage. How to use: - Cleanse your face and neck, then apply two pumps of serum over the entire area. Gently massage and press into the skin.

avis.titre: Not as smoothing as I had hoped
avis.texte: I received this product and was hoping for a nice smooth feeling. It didn't have that. It almost had a tacky like feeling to it. Disappointed

This is a nice addition to an existing skin care routine to add more hydration. Product also smells amazing — nothing fake or irritating or over the top but just enough fragrance to make you feel like you're getting a high end spa experience when you apply the product.

I really like this product! The packaging is so nice and luxurious. It makes me think of the spa. The product is light weight, non-greasy, and absorbs fast. I love how it only takes two pumps to cover the entire face and neck. The scent is light, natural and clean, again, reminding me of a spa. When you apply the product, you get an instant glow and your skin feels soft and smooth. I have noticed improvements in my skins appearance as I have been using this product and will continue to use it and recommend it to my family and friends!
This product has a nice feel, smells clean without too strong of a fragrance. So far the product is working, doesn't break out my face. Would reccomend.

This serum lives up to its brand name "Bare". I do like the fact that it has a little too new fragrance and that it is very smooth going on. I did not know this any antiaging benefits from this product. I used this morning and at night during my routine. After I wash my face and before my moisturizer.

The SKINLONGEVITY® Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide doesn't feel heavy or greasy. My skin looked smoother and more even after about a week of daily use. It works well under makeup.The texture is silky, the scent is light, and a little goes a long way and it's great for sensitive or dry skin.

I waited to leave a review till I used a whole bottle but half way through and I had to review this is like a Miri ale in a bottle my skin is so soft and hardly any bumps it's so smooth and even has a glow

I haven't really used any of this brands skin care before so I was a little skeptical walking in. However, once my face was washed, I went ahead and used this before my moisturizer, and I can tell after just a week that the texture of my skin is smoothing out

avis.titre: I am OBSESSED with this stuff!
avis.texte: I really enjoyed using Bare Minerals Skinlongevity Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum! I got this product in exchange for my honest review. I used this product for about a month so I could form a solid an educated opinion and honestly I am blown away. I used this stuff twice a day, morning and night. I use it after toning but before moisturizing. It has a really thin consistency that makes it easy to spread from my neck and all over my face with about three pumps. It goes on smooth, dries down semi quickly, and isn't sticky at all! It wears extremely well under makeup, dare I say makes my makeup lay even better than normal. As for my skin I've seen improvements in my skins elasticity, brightness, texture, and had less break outs than normal! I love this stuff and will be purchasing more once out to keep in my skin routine.

avis.titre: A little goes a long way
avis.texte: So ive been using this product for about 3 wks now. I wanted to give a decent review. Packaging was very nice, reminded me of something tou would find in a boutique spa. Heavy glass bottle, which made it feel prestigious also makes u wonder how much product it really has. So ive been using it after washing my face and before doing my makeup and the product glides on, doesnt have an offensive scent. It smooths my face out a little extra and makes my skin soft. I like this product a lot.

Love everything about this product! Pleasant smell, super lightweight, and gentle on the skin. I used this product over the course of multiple weeks and noticed a huge difference in my dark spots and texture.i tend to try out skincare products often which sometimes can take a toll on my skin. Prior to receiving this product, my skin barrier was quite irritated and inflamed. I took before and after photos which really highlight the differences in my skin

This skinlongevity serum by Bare Minerals is so nice! My skin is so healthy and smooth! This is definitely the step I was missing in my face routine! I put it on each night before bed and my face is refreshed and nourished by morning. Ready for makeover or just naturally lookin my best.

I used this in the mornings only. It does say you can use it AM/PM however I like to add things into my routine slowly. I definitely found that this calmed any irritation from retinoids/actives. It smells like green tea. Has a good texture but it is a little sticky if that bothers you. I found it worked well with other products and laid perfectly under makeup. Almost worked as a primer which I enjoyed! Would repurchase this!!

avis.titre: Not a bad product but it didn't do anything great for me.
avis.texte: I received this product free in exchange for my honest feedback. As soon as i received the product in the mail i immediately began using it 2x a day. After around 30 days of use I can unfortunately say that it didn't really do anything wonderful for my skin as I had hoped it would. I didn't see any real huge improvement or changes.
This product is wonderful. I have been using it daily since it arrived.

I really love the bare minerals Skinlongevity barrier boosting serum. The texture of the serum is silky, and leaves my face very smooth and soft. There is nothing greasy about this serum. My face tends to get red and splotchy, but using this serum has really calmed my face down. I love it and highly recommend this product.

avis.titre: Love the Serum, Hate the Fragrance
avis.texte: I was super excited to try this serum, and it has some pros and cons. The packaging is nice, the bottle is sleek and the pump is easy to use and disperses product well. I like the lightweight and milky texture it has, it spreads evenly over the skin and stays smooth under makeup. I have very sensitive skin and I'm happy to say this product doesn't break me out! Which is surprising, considering there's added fragrance. I think this serum would be so much better without it, the scent is overwhelming when applying and it doesn't add anything to the skin benefits. Over time I think this product has made my skin look nice and clear but I just feel like it could be even better if there weren't fragrances added.

I have dry, aging skin that's easily irritated, and this serum has been such a treat. It sinks in beautifully, calms redness, and leaves my face feeling soft and plump. After just a couple weeks, my texture is smoother and my skin feels truly nourished,not just coated. It's a staple in my routine now!

avis.titre: Great results from skin smoothing and plumping serum!
avis.texte: I absolutely have fallen in love with this serum! From the first time use I have seen results and they keep getting more noticeable each day. I apply the serum to my face and neck twice a day after cleansing. My skin appears more plumped and my fine lines are much less noticeable. The texture of my skin is smoothing out as well. This serum is great under makeup and does not cause it to flake or dry as it is very moisturizing. My skin looks bright and more youthful all the way around. I am just tickled!
This is a great serum. It goes on smooth and works well under makeup.

I really like this serum! Using 2 pumps as directed is plenty. It feels really good when it's applied and absorbs smoothly, leaving your skin feeling hydrated & nourished. It leaves your skin feeling smooth and soft, no stickiness at all! It does have a faint fragrance to it, but it's not perfume-y. It's like an herbal-mint scent, very light and clean scent. I don't like overly fragrant skincare at all, but this is not that. It's very light, refreshing and I actually like it a lot. As far as results go- I haven't used it long enough to actually see results, but I had to post something because I was given it for my honest review etc etc… Anyway, I think it's great so far, my hopes are high, and in a few months I will come back and do an update Like I said- so far, so good!

I received bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide from BzzAgent in exchange for my honest opinion. This barrier cream is supposed to help strengthen the barrier between your skin and the everyday damage your skin is subjected to from the environment. It also helps reduce signs of aging. I have a noticable difference in some of my fine lines. They are almost gone. My skin also feels hydrated and radiant. The cream has a pleasant scent and goes on super easy and is not greasy at all. I have already purchased another bottle because this will be a part of my skincare regimen from now on.

I am a big fan of BareMinerals, so happy that finally I got a chance to try one of its new products in exchange for an honest review. Having used this serum consistently for a week every night, I can feel the nourishment and refreshing on my skin in the morning. It's light weight, smooth and quick absorbent when being aplied into the skin. A drop can go a long way covering a larger surface in comparison to other serum. No watery, just right. The fragrant is fresh and light, not overwhelming. I put it in the fridge for the cooling effect - just a nice way to treat myself after a long day. I think it is better used for summer. I'll go back to get the full line of this product. Very satisfied!

I tried the bareMineral skinlongevity barrier boosting serum mineral herb complex and I loved it. It's good for signs of aging and I feel like it has helped my skin. The smell is not strong and is amazing for sensative skin.

Bare Minerals does it again! This bottle is your one stop solution to protect your skin barrier, while elevating your self-care experience. The texture is luxurious as it melts and absorbs its powerhouse ingredients of Niacinamide, Zinc & herb potion. I've seen such an improvement in my fine lines, texture, tone and balance of my skin. Not only is my skin HEALED but it's also PROTECTED from future stressors. I love how hydrated and calm my skin looks and feels, and you all too!

This serum is more lotion-like than watery which gives it the slighty heavier feel. It glides and stay smooth though but I can definitely feel the difference with my skin. I have sensitive oily skin so unfortunately i prefer the watery gel type serums. The scent is a very light herby smell that actually smells good in my opinion. As far as the effect, i've just been using it for two weeks so nothing noticeable yet.

avis.titre: I would buy over & over again!!!
avis.texte: I love that even with putting my makeup on after skincare my skin looks soo smooth!! Thenonly thing I changed was that I started using this!!!

avis.titre: worked wonderfully on my oily skin
avis.texte: I love this serum so much. First of all it smells great, very relaxing scent. It also seemed to keep my skin from being as oily or shiny as usual and absorbed into the skin very well. It feels so good when I massage it into my skin and made my skin feel so hydrated. Very refreshing and a new staple in my routine.

After 2 weeks of daily use my skin was definitely softer than before. I didn't notice any visual changes, but 2 is a fairly short time to have noticed a change in appearance. I will definitely continue to use and am optimistic about this product.

I love how the product applies! It's lightweight and absorbs fast. Pairs well with other products and does not leave my skin feeling tacky or heavy. So far, my skin feels more plump and it has reduced a bit of my redness.
Been using daily, seems to smooth, calm, and help hydrate. Lightweight with minimal fragrance. Need to keep using to determine how it helps skin with aging.

The Skinlongevity Barrier Boosting Serum by bareMinerals feels beautiful on your skin and looks beautiful sitting on your counter. The serum is a lightweight formula that works to repair any current damage your skin might have while also protecting against future damage from occurring. I received the product in exchange for an honest, unbiased review. I would say this serum has definitely helped in terms of boosting my skin's barrier, especially now that it is summertime and I am having to be much more diligent protecting my skin from the sun. It has also helped me eliminate unnecessary products from my routine. Now, I can apply my bareMinerals serum and a sunscreen, and I am good to go! Two pumps are recommended for the face and neck; believe me, that is plenty! Luckily, the moments where I was heavy-handed did not result in wasted product. Extra serum gets rubbed into my hands after my face application. I am also very happy to report that using too much of the serum does NOT cause pilling, like so many other products do! There is a spearmint-like scent that goes away as the serum dries down, but it's very pleasant while it lasts. It definitely smells more "natural" as opposed to artificial, but if you are someone who struggles with fragrance I would test the product on a discreet spot to make sure it works for your skin.

avis.titre: This is my new o to serum
avis.texte: This new bareMineral serum is awesome! It does not leave your skin feeling sticky or heavy. It goes on easily and absorbs nicely. It also has a nice light fragrance. I will definitely be buying this again.

This serum made my skin feel really cool and refreshed. It went on light, but left my face feeling moisturized and seemed to improve the texture of my skin. This serum is really nice to use under my makeup.

I use it both in the am and pm! This has been fabulous for me during the summer months! It's so light and refreshing and it leaves my skin feeling so nice. It's so hydrating and my skin has never felt better! Ohhh!! It absorbs quickly! I received this product for free in exchange for my honest review!

The serum was refreshing, soothing and really just complimented my skincare routine. I will say that I noticed some slipping under makeup, so I switched it to a no makeup day routine. The eucalyptus scent is definitely present which may trigger those with sensitivities. I did notice some irritation on the jaw line, t zone areas if I used it daily. Overall, I liked the serum but I'm not entirely sure I'd pick it up again.
I use the serum twice daily. I like its light texture, and it absorbs quickly without leaving a sticky residue.

I've been using this a few weeks now and my skin has never felt so soft! It's been perfect for summer. The consistency isn't too thick and absorbs very well and doesn't leave a sticky feel behind. It has a very light fresh scent upon application that dissipates quickly thereafter.
I liked the product, I noticed big change of my face skin it looks more strong and healthy i really liked the texture it is blended easy to my skin very recommended

I've genuinely loved using this product! From the very first application, I noticed how beautifully it absorbed into my skin. Even though it has a more liquid consistency, it dries down wonderfully without any stickiness or residue. It left my skin feeling fresh, smooth, and hydrated. I've found that four pumps is the sweet spot for full coverage. It glides on effortlessly and layers well under my moisturizer and makeup. One of my favorite parts? The light, refreshing scent—subtle and clean, not overwhelming at all. It adds a lovely touch to my skincare ritual. Overall, I'm really impressed with this formula. It's gentle yet effective, and it's definitely earned a spot in my regular skincare lineup. 💚

It smells nice and the bottle is nice. If my skin is sensitive, this will sting. I also don't care about most of the ingredients and prefer to keep a minimal routine of actives. I enjoyed trying this but I wouldn't pay for it.

I really liked the light feel of this product and that I only needed one pump for my whole face and neck. The smell is also amazing - not strong at all. My skin felt instantly smoother when I put this on, without feeling heavy. I haven't noticed reduced wrinkles, but I haven't been using it long enough for the full effects. I received this item for free in exchange for my honest opinion.

This product is amazing! It feels good, smells good, and goes on leaving your skin looking fresh. It's light on the skin and don't leave anything behind making your skin feel fresh bare and awake. The smell is light and refreshing calming your senses. I would highly recommend this product to anyone who needs a new barrier cream.

I used this serum as instructed, day and night. It made my skin brighter and smoother. It is a bit watery when compared to other serums that are thicker, but it still did a great job at making my face look refreshed. The smell is also amazing! I would recommend!

avis.titre: Good Hydration, But Not a Miracle Worker
avis.texte: After using the Skinlongevity Barrier Boosting Serum for the last four weeks, I can confidently say it has both strengths and weaknesses. It earns a solid 3 stars from me, meaning it isn't bad, but not quite holy grail status either. The texture is lightweight and silky, making it easy and fast to apply and sinks in fairly quickly and layers well under makeup or other skincare. I did notice that my skin felt more hydrated and I had fewer dry patches. However, for a product marketed as "barrier boosting," I expected longer-term improvements and a visible reduction in redness. Unfortunately, I didn't experience those results. My skin didn't feel significantly stronger, and any calming effects were minimal.

avis.titre: Becoming a part of my daily routine!
avis.texte: I am really surprised by this serum. I received this product for free in exchange for an honest review. It is not too thick, hydrating, and really soothing to put on my skin after cleansing in the morning. Since using daily, my skin feels softer and cleaner and I hope with more extended use I will start to see some benefits of the niacinamide.

At first I noticed my skin looking clearer, not as much texture and much more of an even tone. After using for a few weeks I definitely see a reduction in fine lines around my eyes, forehead and laugh lines. Plus it's reduced redness! All around great product.

I've used many lotions on my face and this one wasn't so bad. When I put it on it felt smooth but then all of a sudden it became sticky on my face when I buy this again. Probably not, but it was nice to try

I had an opportunity to try Skinlongevity Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide. This is a great serum with pretty great ability to moisturizing skin. MY skin is normally dry to combiate and I usually get dry spots while gettging bit of oily spots during summer days. Not only this serum kept my skin moist and soft, and alos, it kept my skin strong and created bit of barriers. my skin felt tighter and yet softer using this. my skin looked also moist and gained elasticity. I highly recommend this to anyone who wants to make their skin stronger and feeling moist and soft at the same time.

After a few weeks of using SKINLONGEVITY Barrier Boosting serum, my skin feels moisturized and it helps with the redness on my nose. I wish it listed the amount of niacinamide, so that I can coordinate it better with my other products (not use too much niacinamide for example). It's a bit pricey. However, I do like that it's fast absorbing, moisturizing and light weight enough for the summer. A little goes a long way. The serum doesn't have a strong scent.

If you feel that you need to restore your skin barrier, this serum from Bare Minerals will help you so much. It feels so soothing and after a few days you see improvements in your skin texture. I've had no bad reactions to it.

avis.titre: Smells good, haven't noticed much of a difference
avis.texte: The first thing I noticed about this product was how absolutely beautiful the bottle is. It's glass, has gold accents, and is sheer enough to see the product inside. The serum itself smells herbal, and while I lean more towards floral smells, I don't hate it. It feels hydrating overall and absorbs really well. I haven't noticed much of a lasting difference in my skin aside from after the immediate use making my skin look bright and hydrated. I would keep using it if I had a guarantee of it working, but as of right now I'm not entirely sure about it.
Since using this serum my skin feels softer and looks plumper it's very lightweight formula absorbs quickly—non-sticky and layers well under moisturizer. I also enjoy that it has
This product is a game changer! I've been using it for a few weeks now and I love it! Hydrates my skin so well and very lightweight!

avis.titre: This serum calms my skin AND my senses-I love that for me!
avis.texte: I have been using bareMinerals makeup for years, so when I was offered an opportunity to try the SKINLONGEVITY Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide, I really looked forward to it. For full disclosure, I was sent this complimentary in exchange for my genuine thoughts, so I decided to incorporate it into my A.M. skincare routine to see how I liked it. The serum itself was not heavy or sticky and it did absorb pretty quickly, which I appreciated. Something that I really enjoyed was the calming, light, herbal scent, thanks to the mineral herb complex that is used. It gave my morning a little aromatherapy mood boost, nothing overbearing or strong-in fact the scent disappears soon after applying-but nice, nonetheless. My skin felt extremely well-nourished and healthy when I used this and I also thought that it layered well with my other skincare products and makeup. I also want to mention that there was none of the dreaded pilling that some products will do, so that's a definite plus. I really do like this product, and it honestly ended up exceeding my expectations. A definite staple serum, worthy of a permanent spot in my rotation, and I forgot to mention that I think the glass bottle looks great on my counter. A clean and minimal look.

I was excited to add the SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide to my routine. My skin issues vary depending on the weather and even allergens conditions. Currently my biggest issue is dryness around my forehead, cheeks, and even my brows. My skin feels tight and looks so dry even after applying face moisturizer. Unfortunately the wind and air in my area makes these issue worst during summer and often have to switch current products that helps but do make more issues. I admit that I was doubtful two pumps of the SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum would be sufficient for face and neck but it covers so well and while I do avoid my eyes, I make sure to cover my brows. The scent is so very light and doesn't linger once it absorbs which happens very quickly. The consistency of the product is light and liquidity which makes it easier to apply. I had no issues with side effects. And truthfully, I felt instant comfort after first application. The tightness that I felt due the dryness was gone and I didn't feel it after it absorbed into my skin which has happened with similar products. For this, the Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum is superior to any of the products I have used before. Unfortunately I didn't see any improvements in improving fine lines. While mine and not deep or that visible yet, I didn't see any change. I feel the redness in my cheeks remains. All these after using the product for about 2 weeks straight. Overall, I say the pro

I enjoy using this product because it has a wonderful consistency for layering.It mixes well with other skincare products.I personally use it right after my essence in my skincare routine.Serums with vitamin C or growth factors layer on top of this product seamlessly.I would recommend this product to anyone looking to minimize redness in their skin.
This product is so light and refreshing! It has a slight spa like scent and absorbs quickly into the skin. A little goes a long way leaving your skin feeling silky smooth.

avis.titre: Love the product - still waiting on anti-aging results
avis.texte: I received this product for free in exchange for writing my honest review. I really love this serum. The packaging is sleek, dispenses well and has a lovely scent. It reminds me of a light, herbal, citrus tea. Not overpowering at all. I've been using the serum for a couple of weeks and haven't seen any reduced fine lines or wrinkles but I do feel like my skin tone has been a little less red and my skin has felt plumper. I definitely see myself incorporating this into my skincare routine long term.

I have been absolutely loving this face serum. I'm always looking for serums that fortify my skin barrier since I do tend to have redness and irritation . This has worked wonders for me with that. It's lightweight and sinks right into the skin. I wake up with a nice glow and smooth looking skin. No irritation or redness had occurred. Packaging is user friendly. I definitely so recommend!
I have noticed a difference in my skin since I started using this product. My skin feels hydrated without feeling oily. This product is light weight and easy to apply.

Having dry skin and getting a little bit older, I am always happy to try something new that may be beneficial on numerous fronts. When I had the opportunity to try this new serum, I was anxious to do so. I proceeded with my regular skin care routine, and replaced my normal serum with this product. Surprisingly, my skin burned! Thinking my skin may have been acting different that day or something was just off, the following night I gave it another try with the same results. Wanting to give the product a fair chance, I even changed up to some of the other products that I use and added this to that routine with unfortunately, the same burning results. I wish I could say that this was a positive review, but unfortunately, it was not.

Niacinamide is a miracle ingredient and I've used it in my daily routine for the past year, so I was thrilled to try BareMinerals' version. Right away, I appreciated The Barrier-Boosting Serum high-quality formulation with a hydrating Squalene base. The serum is lightweight with a strong refreshing herbal scent. Unlike many comparable serums, this does not pill even when layering other products saving me a considerable amount of time every morning. The packaging is also so luxurious and sturdy!! It's silly, but I enjoy picking it up everyday because it remains cold to the touch and feels like a nice sculpture. After using this serum for three weeks, I've noticed a fine line reduction and improvement to my skin texture has improved. I also felt that my skin remained hydrated longer, even when I forgot to drink water. This will become my go-to Niacinamide serum moving forward. I highly recommend this product!

avis.titre: So far, a really nice product.
avis.texte: I've been using this serum for a couple of weeks now, and it has created subtle changes in my skin. First off all, the packaging is nice... with a glass bottle and a pump dispenser. The serum itself is of a loose creamy consistency, and it soaks in quickly when applied to my skin. It feels nice on the skin too... it is both cooling and soothing. I have a lot of redness in my face, and I do feel like this serum calms that down, as well as making my heated skin feel so much better. I haven't been using this long enough to notice any anti- wrinkle effects, but I hope I will see those effects with continued use. I love that this product has niacinimide as an ingredient, and my skin definitely feels more hydrated and softer because of it. The scent is also really nice. It smells mildly of essential oils, and isn't a distracting scent at all. Overall, I really like this product so far, and I will continue to use it.
I absolutely love this be barrier cream it's light smells delightful and works like a charm! I will be adding this to my routine!
Light weight serum that gives my skin a glow and without a heavy residue. Great addition to my products that I use regularly.

I was super excited to get a barrier support serum, but unfortunately, my skin started breaking out like crazy. I'm now I'm in the process of trying to get my skin back to how it used to be. I'm not one that it is usually acne prone. I don't know what's going on with my face, maybe it's just the trials of new products. Nonetheless, I'm super sad that I couldn't love this. I will say that the bottle is super cute, I love the colors as it's pretty aesthetic and trendy with what's popular right now. The pump didn't give me any issues at all. The serum itself is pretty lightweight and milky, which I love. I love milky products!!! If you're someone with super sensitive skin, I would just take caution. Everyone skin reacts differently, so what doesn't work for me May work for you. Nonetheless, I think this is a great product and it would work for someone with skin that doesn't react to it.

I was very excited to receive this, so excuse the dry hand picture. The serum is light, almost milky, applies nicely into the skin not leaving a film or a tacky feel in any way. Extremely light scented and after wearing it for hours in FL hot and humid weather conditions my face did not get oily or hot nor itchy. I have been using this consistently (day and night) for a couple of weeks and although I have seen a noticeable difference and I do feel is good for my skin. I plan to include this as part of my beauty regimen, I am 51 years old from the Mediterranean. I did receive this product for free in order to review and provide input.

After using this product for a couple weeks, I do like it. It's very lightweight and moisturizing, however I have not seen a big difference in my fine lines. It's easy to apply and gets absorbed into the skin fast which is nice. It has a very light pleasant scent. I think it's a bit pricey but I could see myself repurchasing it.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I applied it twice a day. It is light scented and lightweight. It does not leave your face feeling oily or sticky. I will definitely continue to use and will purchase again.

I've been using this product for over 2 weeks and i love it. It leaves my skin super hydrated and glowy! It reduced my texture and creates a smooth barrier on my skin before i apply any other product.
I love the consistency of this serum — it's nice and milky. I layer it with my vitamin C and it has been working fantastically to give me a natural glow!

This serum was nice and smooth and absorbed into my skin quickly. It did not feel sticky or tacky. The smell was very pleasant and subtle. It did not feel like I had 15 layers of product on my face when I added my moisturizer on top of it. Product power aside I feel good wearing this. It has been a nice addition to my skin care routine and I plan to maintain it. It's also open my eyes to other products under the bareMinerals umbrella.

avis.titre: Great skincare for the summer heat
avis.texte: SKINLONGEVITY® Barrier Boosting Serum – 2 Week Review (via BzzAgent) I've been using this serum for about 2 weeks now, and I'm really loving it! I have dry skin, and this has been perfect for summer. It's super lightweight, absorbs quickly, and leaves my skin feeling hydrated and glowing. The scent has a light essential oil vibe, which reminds me of a spa. And I have to say, the packaging is really nice. The glass bottle has a good weight to it and feels super luxe on my counter. Overall, it's a great addition to my skincare routine. No irritation, just smooth, happy skin. Definitely recommend trying it if you're looking for a light serum that still delivers results!

I'm a older woman and seeing wrinkles that was never there before got a little concerning . So, I tried Skin Longevity Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamid regularly. I'm so impressed with this Product, it's not like lotion or any other Serum. It goes right into the skin on the face and neck , and soaks in right away. Then you are left with the softness and smell of fresh cucumbers. But wait, it also started to take away the small wrinkles as I was applying everyday. I'm very impressed with the Bare Minerals Brand, and I will be promoting this Serum to all my Friends and Family. Great Job.

Amazing serum that absorbs nicely to the skin and helps hydrate and repair damaged skin. I use it after toner and I was able to see results in about 1 month of use. My skin was softer, clearer, and less textured after using. I received this product in exchange for an honest review.

I enjoyed this serum. The texture upon application is very lightweight. It comes out like a cream but it immediately becomes watery. I appreciate this kind of texture on a serum. Additionally, when you apply it, the sensation is almost cooling, which I also personally like. One thing some people might not like is that it leaves a sticky sensation on the skin. I don't mind it very much but it might bother other people. I do feel my face feels a bit plumper and less red after using this serum. However, I can't say I've seen significant or permanent changes in my skin texture. That might take more time to notice. Another detail that might interest people is the fragrance. This serum has a very noticeable herbal fragrance. Nonetheless, the fragrance doesn't linger. You stop noticing the smell almost immediately after applying it. As a last note, the bottle feels and looks luxurious and the pump is great.

I recieved this product try thanks to Bzzzagent! The product itself is smooth and silky with a nice botanical smell. The serum is thin and feels refreshing, the scent is light and not overpowering. It rubs in well with no sticky after feel. I do feel my skin is somewhat tighter, but with a clean glow. Crows feet seem smoother, and skin looks and feels more hydrated! I wish it was a miracle worker for my deeper forehead lines, but overall I feel the serum is worth continuing to use. Another plus, is also that the packaging feels earthy and pretty, with the bottle itself made of a heavy glass. It feels expensive!

avis.titre: An amazing addition to my skincare routine!
avis.texte: I've been using the bareMinerals SKINLONGEVITY Nourishing Barrier Boosting Serum with Niacinamide for a couple of weeks now, and I'm genuinely impressed. I have only started getting serious about skincare in the past year, so I am definitely not an expert but I'm loving this serum so far. I've been skin flooding for about six months and had good results, so I was a bit nervous about introducing a new product. Fortunately, from the first application, my skin felt smoother, more hydrated, and just healthier overall. The texture is lightweight and absorbs quickly without any sticky residue, making it perfect for both morning and night routines. What I really love is how it calms my skin while giving it a radiant, dewy finish. The niacinamide has helped visibly even out my tone and reduce some redness, especially on my cheeks, while the mineral-rich ingredients give my skin that "just had a facial" glow. I've noticed fewer dry patches around my mouth and chin, and my makeup goes on more smoothly, which is a huge bonus. I love that it's fragrance-free and a little goes a long way so I think this bottle will last a while. I didn't experience any irritation or breakouts after using this serum, which is surprising, so I think it can work well for most skin types. If you're looking for a barrier booster that will give you a glow and reduce redness without irritation, this is the one! Definitely recommend for skin care enthusiasts of all skill levels!

I received Bare Minerals Skinlongevity nourishing barrier boosting serum with niacinamide free in exchange for my opinions. Upon receiving the product, I put it to use immediately that evening. Per the directions on the box, I have used 2 pumps every morning and evening for the past 2 weeks. The serum is silky smooth and easily covers my face and neck. It is light with a soft fragrance that quickly fades, which is great for me. There is a noticeable difference in the color of my cheeks as well as some of my fine lines & wrinkles. At 50 years old, I didn't really expect to see improvement in 2 weeks time. Amazing! I plab to keep using the product & hope to purchase more in the future. I would absolutely recommend this product to all of my friends.

Thank you, bareMinerals, for the Skin Longevity Barrier Boosting Serum. I've been using the serum 2x as day (morning and evening) for a few weeks now, and I can honestly say my skin feels noticeably healthier. The texture of the serum is lightweight. It absorbs quickly without feeling sticky or greasy, which I really appreciate. What I like the most is how gentle the product is. My skin can be sensitive, and this serum hasn't caused any irritation or breakouts. Instead, the boosting serum makes my skin feel smooth & plump without redness. The niacinamide and herbal complex seem to be an excellent combination because I've noticed a reduction in fine lines and wrinkles! I pair it with a moisturizer for added hydration before applying my makeup in the morning. You only need a small amount of this serum, so it lasts a long time. I plan to continue to use this in my daily skincare routine and highly recommend it.

I have been using this product every morning and evening since I received a sample about 2-3 weeks ago. My face is so smooth and I have noticed a reduction in redness. I love the scent, it reminds me of fresh greenery like a leaf or an aloe plant. My only critique is that the cap doesn't really fit so it's difficult to open and close. I ended up throwing my cap away.
The new Bare Minerals skin serum is amazing! I love having a serum that protects and strengthens my skin barrier. I look forward to seeing how my the wrinkles react to this over time.

avis.titre: The missing product from my regimen!
avis.texte: This has been a surprisingly wonderful product! I never expected to love it as much as I do. I've been using it in both my nighttime and morning routines. It's truly a product that I didn't even realize was missing from my skincare regimen. I have been using it for several weeks now and I wish I had taken a before picture to show you. My skin looks so alive again! As a woman enduring perimenopause (and all that comes with it), this has been a very beneficial product. I would highly recommend it to anyone. * I received this product for free in exchange for my review.

Received this product for free in exchange for my honest review. I've been using this serum for a few weeks now and have noticed visible improvement in my skins texture and the appearance in my fine lines. This serum is lightweight, non-sticky and leaves your skin hydrated and plump. I love that it's suitable for all skin types!

I was given this product to try for free in exchange for my honest review and opinion. I have been using this product for about 2 weeks now, I wanted to make sure I didn't get any reactions to it and so far so good! It's a smooth product and goes on my skin easily. It has a white clearing color with a smooth consistency and smells a little like mineral sunscreen. It goes on and penetrator my skin and I can put my makeup and other products on just fine.

I prefer more thicker facial products. If you don't have dry skin like me since I am in texas this products will work for you. Personally it's just not for me. Hardly has no scent so if you don't like scented then it's for you. I got the product for free in exchange for writing the review. Super thankful to test it out. I still use it in mornings and then apply a moisturizer.

avis.titre: A must for combo to oily skin
avis.texte: This Skinlongevity Barrier Boosting Serum is just what my combination, leaning oily skin needed! My skin drank this serum up. It left my skin smooth, supple, yes matte, brighter and not tight or dry. It did not pill ever. Your skin will thank you.

This product was gifted to me for free. Feels like a light weight serum moisturizer. Does a good job at hydrating my dry skin. Has a light sweet herbal scent very natural smell. I will continue to use it.

avis.titre: Loved adding this to my routine
avis.texte: Since adding this barrier booster serum from bare minerals to my skin care routine I've noticed my skin has been brighter and more glowy. I love that it has niacinamide and other great ingredients.
I loved the way this made my skin feel so soft and smooth. It smells so good, it went on smooth and it wasn't greasy. I would definitely recommend this to family and friends.

I received this as a sample in exchange for a review and let me tell you this stuff is amazing! I will absolutely be ordering this again and again. The scent is light and fresh and not overpowering. The serum absorbs nicely without any feeling of stickiness and residue. It made my skin feel fresh and soft and smooth! 5 stars for sure! Love this stuff!
A good feeling nourishing serum that has great ingredients for repairing a compromised skin barried. Lightweight nourishing serum with a light fresh scent

My skin definitely felt nourished with this amazing serum! It goes on so smooth and soaks in quickly, leaving my skin hydrated and feeling plump. I love the gentle scent and the texture. It doesn't leave me feeling greasy or weighed down. Very light weight and wonderful under my makeup.

This product smells really nice at first applying and end dry. Each pump out seamlessly and does not run on the face. After applying, my face felt tight and very soft at touch. I looked forward to the next time I was able to apply this.

avis.titre: A Necessity in my Skincare Routine
avis.texte: I have a multi step skincare routine for both day and night and this incorporates easily into my existing serum step. The texture is like a lightweight lotion serum and it absorbs quickly and smoothly without any sticky residue. It has a very fresh and spa-like scent, which I found very comforting and refreshing. After using this daily for several weeks I've noticed I have a smoother skin texture and less oil production. I was lucky enough to be able to try this serum for free in exchange for a review, I love the results I'm seeing so far and will definitely replenish this bottle when I'm out!

The product feels great on my skin. It's a thin, milky consistency and goes on so smooth, smells nice and leaves my skin feeling hydrated! I put it on at night after my shower and I love the way it feels! The packaging is nice as well.

avis.titre: My sking is glowing and feeling health
avis.texte: I started using the bareMinerals Barrier boosting serum and I'm loving it. I'm 43 and my skin is starting to show age signs, but this product is making me feel renewed, my skin has improved a lot , and I see reduction in the fine lines .

avis.titre: Yes, I would totally buy this product.
avis.texte: I would first wash my face, then I would apply a toner before using the barrier boosting serum. It wasn't sticky or greasy after it dried. It left my skin feeling soft. I wanted to use this product for at least a week before submitting a review! I have another barrier boosting product from a line of products I use. I prefer this one!

avis.titre: The bare minerals skinlongevity barrier feels amazing on my
avis.texte: The bare minerals skinlongevity barrier feels amazing on my Skin! I can actually feel it nourishing and protecting my skin. I put it on, I will definitely buy this product.

The Bare Minerals Skinlongevity Nourshing Barrier Boosting Serum made such a big difference in my skin and fine lines. They were less noticeable after a couple of uses. The texture of my skin was much smoother and more radiant.
This serum is great for the humid summer for someone with combo skin. It's lightweight but keeps my skin hydrated and doesn't break me out

This product was okay, it definitely made my skin feel soft after application but outside of that I didn't notice any changes. The serum's consistency is nice and the smell is a little herbal but not bad. Did not cause any breakouts or any other issues.
I like this skin serum a lot and it goes on my skin really well absorbing quickly !
